title: Analytical Holders - Models 643, 646, 650, 925
supported_facts: 643 is a single-tilt and 646 a double-tilt room-temperature analytical holder; the tip leaves clearance for the electron beam and EDS lines of sight, and a Be cradle reduces background.
unsupported_claims: The webpage provides no engineering drawing of ordinary shaft length, external handle diameter or tip thickness.
Be is the cradle material of that product; this does not imply that the entire holder or this project's holder is Be.
access_note: The original text was readable through web search; direct HTML download returned 429, and the 643/646 datasheet URLs returned HTML instead of PDF. Failure receipts are retained; no original PDF was fabricated.
